scope: Actual source helpers and language controller callbacks in Node VM, deterministic timers and minimal API facade. This checks prototype state isolation/cancellation/target capture, not DOM/CSS, semantic analysis, actual compiler/tests/LSP/DAP or Windows execution.

tests.name: Per-file breakpoints do not leak to another file or project
Three language states are independent
Renaming a run configuration preserves the selected language and entry
Windows Java uses each project wrapper; POSIX uses its native spelling
Maven build and Spring runtime profiles remain distinct in the command
Skip-tests preference cannot suppress an explicit Maven Test action
Python commands use the selected interpreter and preserve a spaced Windows path
Python command display quotes shell metacharacters and POSIX apostrophes
Import display follows the selected platform and interpreter
Frontend commands use selected package manager and distinct test/build targets
Test fixture results point to each selected language, not a shared TS test
Missing source fails fixture checks instead of creating passing results
Opening a language never overwrites an existing edited manifest
Unconfigured Java cannot report a successful run
A running operation captures command/name and source before later edits
Results visibly become stale after a checked buffer changes
A later non-test run cannot erase test revision provenance
Late completion cannot change the viewed project or render its editor
Concurrent project operations stop and finish independently
Stop invalidates an already captured callback and permits a new run
Stale callback cannot remove the cancellation handle of a replacement run
Changing a scenario applies to the next run, never to pending completion
Stopping an import leaves the previous readiness and does not complete later
Debug step remains bound to the captured file after opening another editor
Frontend debugger displays a frame matching its actual source fixture
Deleted debug source cannot step into a different active file
Debug continue cancellation rejects its pending successful exit
A paused debugger prevents another run in that same profile
Background profiles retain aggregate running state until all finish
Spring server completion reports its captured profile until explicitly restarted
Deleted Spring navigation target cannot focus a line in an unrelated document
Old dialog callbacks reject another project before applying settings
Preview fix refuses a buffer changed after its review was opened
Coverage never fabricates a measured percentage from fixture success
User collapse during a run survives both success and failure completion
Debug with an unprepared toolchain reveals its repair instructions
